comment: Tough exams
I mean this guy is so nice so I feel bad but just not a great teacher at all. His tests are so unbelievably hard the extra credit kinda makes up for it but its not really enough
Dr. Paik gives a lot of extra credit. Easy 90%+ before final as long as you attend the lecture and pay attention. But just good luck on the final.

Prof. Paik is so so nice and has a good sense of humor but I do not think he is a very good professor. He sometimes struggles to articulate things which can make learning accounting very challenging. Much of his class felt like a guessing game at times. He is very sweet but I would not recommend him for accounting.

I had to drop out of Prof Paik's managerial accounting course because I failed both midterms. They were very difficult and long. He rarely responded to my emails. Classes were easy and he went through a lot of the quizzes, but he really didn't teach. I'm retaking the class with a different professor next semester, hoping to click better.

The class is very manageable and easy up until the final which was worth almost 50% of your grade (yes thats right). The final was very long and definitely challenging compared to the first 2 exams. If you do well in the class up until the final, you will be okay still.

Nice guy but his grading is flat out unfair. He does not curve tests, the class average was a C- on the final (worth roughly 44% of the final grade) and he did not curve. He also does not answer questions in class because he "wants us to think hard about it". Super nice and funny guy but the class is not worth it in my opinion.

His method of teaching (or lack thereof) is completely unfair to students who actually want to learn. He expects you to immediately know how to complete the handouts. Yes, he gives extra credit, but that only takes you so far. You have to teach everything to yourself, and if you hate accounting/find it hard, do not take him

The material in this course is somewhat easy but the tests are difficult which balances things out. Based on tests alone, it is pretty tough to get an A in this class, but Professor Paik gives out a ton of participation based on extra credit in this class. It is straightforward to get ahead and to get the grade that you want if you put in the work.
Literally one of the best professors if you are looking for an A and to actually learn take him.

Paik is super generous with extra credit (.5 points/question) which is helpful because the exam problems are all or nothing - no partial credit. He reads from the publisher-produced slides and then gives out problems to work on. Exams are much harder than the handouts even though the questions look similar - beware! He cracks jokes in class often.

Dr. Paik is generous with extra credit and allows a cheat sheet for exams; however, on our last exam of the semester, he completely pulled the rug out from under us and gave us the hardest exam of my college career. He then sent me personally and the whole class very cold, condescending, and unprofessional emails. Not sure why he changed so fast.

Professor Paik is the kindest professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and wants us to succeed. The class consists of weekly quizzes and 5 tests, but he offers extra credit opportunities.

Just the way he talks and reacts is pretty funny. Like if you answer a question wrong during class, he will savagely shut you down with his "WRONG!" (he says it in a joking manner). Answer his questions and you will get .5 extra credit per question with a 1 point max per chapter. Exams were pretty easy with his 3 pages of notes policy (for covid).

If you really want to learn ACC202, Paik is simply not the one... His lectures are confusing and boring. The only reason why students give him good ratings is because often times he gives the tests similar to the homework but that is not the case. You basically have to self teach yourself for this class.
His teaching makes everything so confusing. Tests are harder than his teaching quality.
His teaching style made it difficult for me to understand the material, as there is a lot of it... and before I could fully understand one thing we were already onto the next.

Paik is a really funny and nice guy. I found his class easy but I'd also taken accounting before and am an accounting major. I don't think he's a great teacher tbh but he gives a ton of extra . credit randomly and the homeworks are all super easy and usually not even graded. His tests are average. Overall a pretty chill class that isn't too hard

Great teacher. He was funny and made accounting as interesting as possible. I frequently went to his office hours and he really took a lot of time to further explain things. He has a lot of quizzes, but he usually ends up doing them with you in class. Gives a lot of extra credit.  I'd highly recommend him for acct202.
He is chill and fun. Tests and exams are easy.

He is awesome. Always be there for you and super hilarious in the class. He is basically one of the easiest professor I have ever taken in UR. His quizzes account for almost 15% of total grades and he gives you answers for them!!!!!!

I had Professor Paik for both IBUS 381 and Accounting 201. He is great! He genuinely cares about his students and wants them to do well. He made both classes interesting and not painful to sit through. If you have a chance to take IBUS 381 over May term and go on the South Korea trip, definitely do it! Lots of fun and learned a lot.
He is an extremely funny guy. However, he does NOT teach. Paik expects you to pretty much teach yourself. Not a whole lot of work but you definitely have to read the book if you wanna do well.

Dr. Paik is not only a great professor but when it comes to the IBUS trip, he is a great reference for all things international business pertaining to South Korea. He was a fantastic guide as we toured around South Korea. Not to mention, he is very funny and makes both the trip and the class an awesome experience.
Paik is a great teacher! As an IB major, I had to take accounting & he made it VERY understandable. His classes go by very fast and he's very funny & entertaining in class
Great guy, great class.  If you go to class you don't really have to read the book.  Easy A with minimal to no work, and you learn a lot.  Definitely take his class.

Have had two semesters with Paik and am signing up for a 3rd.  He is always willing to help or accommodate and is usually successful at making accounting hilarious while actually teaching students a lot. Is easily the best professor i've had and I would recommend him to anyone!!

Had him for 201;this year, structured my classes around ensuring I'd have him again for 202.He's by far the best prof.He gives group quizes, and his preclass quizes are taken from a bank of ~15 questions he provides online with answers.He helps the class during the quizes and is always there to help when you need it. Also, the funniest prof ever.

Dr. Paik goes out of his way to make sure his students excel in his class. He is approachable and succeeds at turning a dry subject into one that is quite entertaining and fun to learn. I give him two thumbs up!

Doctor Paik is one of the most phenomenal and memorable professors. His teaching methods are very fun & comprehensive & the knowledge you gain is easily embedded in your head so that you can apply it to other accounting and finance courses. Paik is always available to help & conveys complicated accounting principles in a very understandable manner.

Dr. Paik is an outstanding professor. He makes it very clear what material you need to know and is always willing to help you in and outside of class. Most importantly, he is hilarious and he brings many "teaching aids" to class which makes it much more enjoyable. I would recommend Dr. Paik to anyone who wants or has to take ACCT 202

Greatest teacher ever! Makes accounting fun and is the nicest man in the world. I'm not even an accounting major and I'm taking one of his classes next semester just because he is teaching it.  He truly cares about his students and will help you any time you need it out of class.  Tests can be difficult, but what accounting test isn't?
Dr. Paik is the best teacher I have had at Richmond. His classes are challenging, but very understandable. If you listen in class and do the practice exams you're guaranteed an A.

Dr. Paik is definitely one of the better professors at Richmond. He is great at explaining dull accounting concepts in a fun and engaging way, and he could not be a nicer guy. His class is actually enjoyable to attend. His exams are not easy, but go to his review sessions and meet with him one on one and you'll be fine. Absolutely take Dr. Paik.

Dr. Paik is by far one of the best professors at Richmond! He makes the material so much easier to understand and his classes are actually fun. He's such a great guy and he really wants the best for his students. He's a very fair grader and is more than willing to help each individual student. TAKE ONE OF HIS CLASSES! I promise you won't regret it!

Dr. Paik was a fantastic professor!  He really cares about each student and always strives to help them in any way he can.  He also makes class fun and interesting.  One of my favorite professors in the B-School and at U of R!  I would highly recommend Dr. Paik!

Dr. Paik is an amazing professor. He is incredibly engaged and excited to teach. The subject matter was not incredibly exciting but he makes it interesting and fun to learn. He is willing to help students as much as possible because he truly cares about his student's success. His tests can be challenging but he is the best professor I have had yet!
Best professor ever! One of the most interesting class that i have ever attended!

Probably my favorite professor so far at U of R! He does an amazing job simplifying the information and presenting it in an interesting way. His tests and can be difficult but he is more than willing to help you with anything you dont understand. All of the courses he teaches are awesome, take him!

One of my favorite professors at the university. He is pretty hilarious and really entertaining. He keeps class fun and really want everyone to get an A, and makes that pretty evident in how much he tries to help every individual. If you don't take this teacher, HUGE mistake!
awesome professor. definitely recommending

Dr. Paik is awesome.  Makes the class interesting and gives easy group quizzes.  Won't let you leave class until you get every answer correct. Tests are more challenging but still manageable.  Paik is funny and entertaining in class. Doesn't give homework other than reading and blackboard quizzes.

Dr. Paik has quite a personality. He is very difficult to understand at times. But he is quirky, fun, and makes a very boring subject interesting and entertaining. I would pick him over any other accounting professor at U of R.
